raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "2.5.9"

package:
  name: professor
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://gitlab.com/hepcedar/professor/-/archive/professor-${{ version }}/professor-professor-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 201b95e701d1ac6071ba27968a6617fe7b8a2f481112d7a0eb4dc90d4f94f5e2
  patches:
    - update-to-python3.patch

build:
  number: 1
  skip:
    - win

requirements:
  run_exports:
    - ${{ pin_subpackage("professor", upper_bound="x.x") }}
  build:
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - make
    - sed
    - pkg-config
    - gnuconfig
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - cython
  host:
    - python
    - cython
    - pip
    - setuptools
    - eigen
  run:
    - python
    - emcee
    - h5py
    - iminuit
    - matplotlib-base
    - numpy
    - pydoe
    - pyyaml
    - scikit-learn
    - scipy
    - sympy
    - tabulate
    - yoda

tests:
  - package_contents:
      bin:
        - prof2-ls
        - prof2-ipol
        - prof2-tune
        - prof2-sample
        - prof2-config
      lib:
        - Professor2
      include:
        - Professor/Professor.h

  - python:
      imports:
        - professor2
        - professor2.core
      pip_check: true

  - script:
      - prof2-ls --help
      - prof2-ipol --help
      - prof2-tune --help
      - prof2-sample --help

      - prof2-bootstrap --help
      - prof2-config --help
      - prof2-eigentunes --help
      - prof2-envelopes --help
      - prof2-ipol --help
      - prof2-ls --help
      - prof2-ncoeffs --help
      - prof2-predict --help
      - prof2-residuals --help
      - prof2-runcombs --help
      - prof2-sample --help
      - prof2-sens --help
      - prof2-tune --help

      - prof2-config --help
      - prof2-config --prefix
      - prof2-config --includedir
      - prof2-config --libdir
      - prof2-config --cppflags
      - prof2-config --ldflags
      - prof2-config --version

      - test "$(prof2-config --version)" = "${PKG_VERSION}"

  - files:
      source:
        - test/testIpol.cc
    requirements:
      run:
        - cxx-compiler
    script:
      # Minimal compiler activation does not export CXX, so fall back to the
      # host-prefixed driver (x86_64-conda-linux-gnu-c++, *-apple-darwin*-clang++).
      - CXX="${CXX:-$(ls "${PREFIX}"/bin/*-c++ "${PREFIX}"/bin/*-clang++ 2>/dev/null | head -n1)}"
      - $CXX -std=c++17 $(prof2-config --cppflags) test/testIpol.cc $(prof2-config --ldflags) -o testIpol
      - ./testIpol

about:
  summary: A tuning tool for Monte Carlo event generators
  description: |
    Professor is a tuning tool for Monte Carlo event generators, based on the ideas
    described in "Tuning and Test of Fragmentation Models Based on Identified
    Particles and Precision Event Shape Data" (Z. Phys., C73 (1996) 11-60).
  license: GPL-3.0-only
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://professor.hepforge.org
  repository: https://gitlab.com/hepcedar/professor
  documentation: https://professor.hepforge.org/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - admorris
